SHELL := /bin/bash
VERSION := $(shell tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)
IMAGE := qurio:v$(VERSION)
PLATFORM := linux/amd64

.PHONY: help dev build test test-go test-web test-e2e lint docker-build release-archive check-release-contract clean

help:
	@awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*## "} /^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*## / {printf "%-20s %s\n", $$1, $$2}' $(MAKEFILE_LIST)

dev: ## Run backend and frontend development servers
	./scripts/dev.sh

build: ## Build the React application and Go binary
	npm --prefix web ci
	npm --prefix web run build
	rm -rf internal/webui/dist
	mkdir -p internal/webui/dist
	cp -R web/dist/. internal/webui/dist/
	CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/hkjang/qurio/internal/version.Version=$(VERSION)" -o dist/qurio ./cmd/qurio

test: test-go test-web ## Run unit and component tests

test-go: ## Run Go tests
	go test ./...

test-web: ## Run frontend tests
	npm --prefix web test -- --run

test-e2e: ## Run browser end-to-end tests
	npm --prefix web run test:e2e

lint: ## Run Go and frontend static checks
	go vet ./...
	npm --prefix web run lint
	npm --prefix web run typecheck

check-release-contract: ## Validate version and offline release naming contract
	@test -n "$(VERSION)" && [[ "$(VERSION)" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$$ ]]
	@./scripts/validate-release-contract.sh

docker-build: check-release-contract ## Build the linux/amd64 qurio:vVERSION image
	docker build --platform $(PLATFORM) --build-arg VERSION=$(VERSION) -t $(IMAGE) .

release-archive: docker-build ## Export the offline image as qurio-vVERSION.tar.gz
	mkdir -p release
	docker save $(IMAGE) | gzip -n -9 > release/qurio-v$(VERSION).tar.gz
	./scripts/verify-offline-image.sh release/qurio-v$(VERSION).tar.gz $(IMAGE)
	sha256sum release/qurio-v$(VERSION).tar.gz > release/qurio-v$(VERSION).tar.gz.sha256

clean: ## Remove generated build artifacts
	rm -rf dist web/dist internal/webui/dist release test-results playwright-report
